encounter: P12 play_order 136, E0162 TRAINER_MARTHA (regular, Mega Banette), Route110 Trick House puzzle 3, cap 42
availability_audit: Same chronology anchor as play_order 135: after Ashen Woods, before Norman, live cap 42, no Surf. Every member is in work/reference-pools/pool-42.json with gate <= 42 and a source map already walked. Houndoominite's stone window is 42 and the Mega Ring was earned from Steven in C13, so the Mega is legal in this window. Altering Cave (Porygon-Z) is accepted here on the same basis as the earlier cap-36 block manifest at work/playtest/party-cap36-post-wattson.json. Route 118 and New Mauville sources are excluded. No legendary, mythical, Ultra Beast or Paradox species is used.
plan: Martha is two Ghosts, a Fairy and a Psychic, so Dark is 2x into three of the four and Poison/Steel answers the fourth. The build is deliberately almost all special for two reasons: Mega Banette gets Prankster, so its Will-O-Wisp resolves before anything I can do about it, and a special attacker does not care about the resulting burn. Two members are structurally immune to the room's main damage: Porygon-Z is Normal, so Poltergeist and Shadow Ball do literally nothing to it, and Mega Houndoom is Fire/Dark, so it cannot be burned at all and is immune to Meowstic's Psychic. Crucially, Houndoom's Dark typing also makes it immune to Prankster-boosted status moves, which is the specific answer to Mega Banette's whole identity. No member of this party carries a stat-lowering move or ability aimed at Meowstic-F: Competitive turns any such drop into +2 Special Attack on a Life Orb attacker, so Incineroar and Intimidate are deliberately left at home.
